properties.site-address: Artique at The Marine, Marina Arms, The Wynd
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: Land occupied by existing commercial premises and adjacent car parking within an established residential area. The building has had numerous past uses, including as a pub and restaurant, but is currently occupied by an antiques business and associated cafe. The site potentially offers a highly attractive location for a residential scheme. Demolition of the existing building required prior to redevelopment. An application for site clearance and construction of 7 homes was recently permitted (19/00730/FUL).T his application is minded to approve subject agreement of the S106. The proposal is for a scheme comprising of high-quality, sustainable homes. Development yet to commence but completion is forecast within the next 5 years.
